brand_identity.name: Ecovera Sourcing
brand_identity.visual_mood: Swiss-style precision, Industrial scale, Clean lines, High contrast

headings.usage: All section headers, hero titles, and major callouts. Use tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Paragraphs, data tables, form labels. Use relaxed line-height (1.6).

mono.usage: Order IDs, SKU numbers, technical specs.

primary.description: Deep Obsidian Blue - Use for backgrounds in dark mode, text in light mode.

secondary.description: Ice Grey - Use for secondary backgrounds, card fills.

accent.description: Electric Trust Blue - Use for Primary CTAs, active states, key highlights.

muted.description: Metallic Silver - Use for borders, dividers, subtext.

marketing.container_style: Asymmetrical layouts, overlapping elements, parallax scrolling.

portal.container_style: Card-based dashboard, sidebar navigation, data tables.

buttons.style: Sharp corners or small radius (rounded-md). No pill shapes.
buttons.animation: Scale down slightly on click (active:scale-95). Hover brightness boost.

cards.marketing: Glassmorphism or solid white with heavy shadow (shadow-xl).
cards.portal: Flat white with 1px border (border-slate-200). Minimal shadow.

inputs.style: Shadcn default but with 'h-12' for better touch targets on marketing pages.

navigation.portal: Fixed sidebar (dark mode preferred for contrast) or top bar.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on solid backgrounds to prevent 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.borders: Tracing Beam effect on pricing cards and key feature highlights.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Layered shadows: shadow-sm for depth + shadow-blue-500/10 for glow.

hero_background.description: High-angle modern warehouse, clean lines. Use with heavy dark overlay.

services_logistics.description: Aerial cargo ship on blue ocean. Perfect for 'Global Logistics' service.

services_manufacturing.description: Robotic arm welding. Use for 'Manufacturing' or 'Quality Control'.

about_team.description: Top view of corporate meeting. Dynamic angle for 'About Us'.

why_us_detail.description: Lone forklift in aisle. Use for 'Warehousing' or specific feature highlight.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a hybrid corporate site + client portal. The marketing side must feel premium, trustworthy, and 'Swiss'. The portal side must be dense, functional, and data-first.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_setup: Install 'Outfit' and 'DM Sans' via Google Fonts. Configure Tailwind colors to match the palette exactly.
instructions_to_main_agent.layout_rules: Do NOT use standard Bootstrap columns. Use the 'Bento Grid' for the Services section. Use 'Tracing Beam' effects for the Quote Request form.
instructions_to_main_agent.portal_specifics: The Client Portal (Dashboard, Orders, Suppliers) should use a Sidebar layout. Use Shadcn 'Table', 'Card', and 'Badge' components heavily here.
instructions_to_main_agent.logo_handling: The logo is Gold/Black. Ensure it is placed on a dark background (Header/Footer) or use a monochrome version if placing on white (filter: grayscale(100%)).
instructions_to_main_agent.animations: Use 'framer-motion' for entrance animations (fade-up) on all marketing pages. Keep the portal static/snappy.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
